description.content: Once you deal with the Creepers, before you continue heading straight, turn to your left to find the first camp.
Up the ladder from the water, the camp is straight ahead.
On the second floor of the parking tower. It's part of a cutscene, so you can't miss it.
In the corner on the roof of the parking tower.
After leaving the parking tower by using two fusion coils to open a shutter, you'll find a camp beneath the statue opposite you.
While exploring the Abandoned Station, you’ll zipline up a rope in an elevator shaft. When you leap out of this elevator shaft, directly in front of you will be the Abandoned Station Supply Camp.
After taking the monorail to the Flooded Commercial Sector, take the steps down and exit the station. Directly opposite the exit, you'll find the Flooded Commercial Sector Camp.
After using the code to enter the Plaza in the Flooded Commercial Sector during the main story, look to your right to see the Plaza Entryway Supply Camp.

collectibles.title: Path to the Victory Monument Camp

description.content: Found on the path to the Victory Monument in the Flooded Commercial Sector. After making your way through the locked door in the area with the giant clock tower, you'll arrive in a small area looking out over the Victory Monument. Descend to the area's lowest point, and you'll find another camp.

images.alt: Path to the Victory Monument Camp

description.content: After defeating the Corruptor boss, you'll make your way through an alley that leads out to an area with a ladder leading to the highway above. Climb the ladder and, when you reach the top, look to your right to spot another camp.
In the centre of the Construction Zone area. On the same level as the area you drop in at. Above the two previous collectibles (in-between them).
After crossing over the steel beam, this camp is through the door on the left.
Take the rope back up, go left down the tunnel and then right to find this camp.
Just to the right, up the rocks, when you enter the Crater area. Hard to miss.

Directly behind you at the beginning of the level, between Adam's tetrapod and Lily's workshop. Can't be missed, as it's the main base of operations and you'll be visiting it frequently.

Note: this camp does not count toward the Meticulous Explorer trophy.

Outside the Presence Chamber (following Adam, as part of the story).

Note: this camp does not count toward the Meticulous Explorer trophy.
As soon as you enter the area. However, you need to restore power at the Solar Tower to use it (side quest, "Reboot").
Southwest of the previous supply box is the Barren Land Legion Camp.
You'll find this camp east of the Solar Tower.
East of the large ship (and south-southeast of the Solar Tower Entrance Supply Camp) is this Supply Camp.
East of the previous Supply Camp is this Legion Camp.
In the south east corner of the area just before you take the elevator down towards Altess Levoire.
Directly before the entrance to Altess Levoire.
As soon as you enter the Scrap Plains from the Barren Lands.
Northeast of the previous shack is a literal bus stop which doubles up as a camp.
When you get through the wallrunning tutorial as you head south, there'll be a camp on the left.
Follow the path down from the northeast and you'll come to a small robot town (Scrap Yard), as well as this Supply Camp.
When back on earth, going to fight the Elder Naytiba, this camp is on the left after you see the message from Raven.
Found just after the long corridor of capsules in Altess Levoire. After fighting your first Infector and proceeding into the corridor ahead, you’ll see it on your left.
In the corridor right after the platforming course where you have to jump on the platforms in the correct symbol pattern.
Found at the entrance to the Top Secret Research Complex area, directly after taking the elevator down from the Specimen Preservation Lab following the laser puzzle.
Found on the second floor of the Deteriorated Lobby, which is accessed after surviving the laser fight on the ground floor. It’s directly ahead of you when you exit the elevator.

collectibles.title: Bottom of the Heart of the Infection Camp

description.content: Found in the area you reach right before the Maelstrom fight. After leaving the ventilation shaft, you’ll climb into a large room filled with mutated tendrils. The camp is on your right.

images.alt: Bottom of the Heart of the Infection Camp

description.content: When arriving on the Matrix 11 landing pad, leave the ship and you'll see the supply camp directly on your left.

Found while exploring the Closed Off Platform in Matrix 11. During the main path of the area, you'll defeat a Skull Berserker and descend into a workshop. Directly ahead of where you enter, you'll see a camp.

After exiting the landfill by using a fusion cell, you'll wind up in a long subway tunnel. Follow it until you see a long bridge ahead. At the entrance to this area, you'll see a camp just to your left.
After arriving at the top of the bridge's first half and opening the shutter ahead, you'll see the Supply Camp to your left.
After descending from the bridge and into the tunnels below, you'll come across the drug store just to the left of a long ramp leading through a broken subway car. Head inside and you'll find a camp.
Found in the Rail Yard in Matrix 11. This camp is unmissable, as Eve will activate and rest at it during a cutscene.

Found after bypassing the first area of the Underground Sewers in Matrix 11 and making your way down to the entrance to Rotten Labyrinth. Right before entering the door to the Rotten Labyrinth, you'll find the camp in the door leading to the area.
After entering the abandoned survivor hideout past the first fusion cell door in the Rotten Labyrinth, head to the second floor and you'll see a camp on your left.
Found at the very end of the Rotten Labyrinth section of Matrix 11. After completing the elevator fight at the end of the section, you'll arrive at a small area with the supply camp.

Found in the room directly after the Temporary Armoury Supply Camp. Defeat the Juggernaut boss in the room, then head for the exit on the second floor in the back left-hand corner. Next to the shutter you need to head through to exit, you'll find the camp.

Found after using the passcode to exit the Train Graveyard. As you make your way through the exit, you'll arrive on a walkway with stairs leading to the exit. To your left as you enter this room, you'll find the camp.

collectibles.title: Contaminated Water Purification Plant Entrance Supply Camp

description.content: Found directly before the boss encounter with the second Alpha Naytiba. This camp is unmissable, as Eve activates it during a cutscene.

images.alt: Contaminated Water Purification Plant Entrance Supply Camp

description.content: As soon as you land in the Great Desert, look to your left and you'll see the supply camp beneath a Hotel Highway sign, right next to the Tetrapod. Requires you to activate the Solar Tower before it can be used.

You'll find it on the second floor of the ruined building at the marker. To get to the second floor, you'll need to move the orange box on the lower floor of the building to climb up to it. Requires you to activate the Solar Tower before it can be used.
When arriving at the Solar Tower, climb the overpass just south of the tower. At the end of the road, you'll find the supply camp. Requires you to activate the Solar Tower before it can be used.

collectibles.title: Way to the Solar Tower Supply Camp

description.content: You'll find it next to the path to the collapsed tunnel you access during the Fallen Angel side mission. Requires you to activate the Solar Tower before it can be used.

images.alt: Way to the Solar Tower Supply Camp
Way to the Solar Tower Supply Camp

description.content: You'll find the camp through a crumbled wall with a red barrel you can blow up. It's just in front of a shop labelled 'Caliente.' Requires you to activate the Solar Tower before it can be used.
The camp is found just south of the long road covered in hidden mines. Requires you to activate the Solar Tower before it can be used.
You'll find the camp southeast of the Oasis lake, next to a locked gate and to the right of a tunnel made of rubble and street signs. Requires you to activate the Solar Tower before it can be used.

Found in the centre of the Buried Ruins area in the Great Desert. After climbing up to the rooftop where you fight Abaddon in the An Eye for An Eye, A Tooth for a Tooth side mission, head to the back of the rooftop and you'll see a fire escape leading down.
You'll find it on a desert path leading between some ruined buildings. Requires you to activate the Solar Tower before it can be used.
You'll find it just next to the gate leading to the area by the Hyper Tube. Requires you to activate the Solar Tower before it can be used.
You'll find it to the left of a sign reading “Licensed Car Service”, behind the destroyed Hypertube. Requires you to activate the Solar Tower before it can be used.
Found on the passage leading back to Xion in the Great Desert. As you walk to Xion, you'll find the supply camp on your right. Requires you to activate the Solar Tower before it can be used.
Found just south of the Tetrapod. You'll find it in front of a ruined building with a moveable orange crate inside. Requires you to activate the Solar Tower before it can be used.

Found in the Northern Desert area of the Great Desert. You'll find the camp to the left of the entrance to the Hypertube, which you ride down during the King of the Tunnel side quest. Requires you to activate the Solar Tower before it can be used.

Found in the north Buried Ruins area of the Great Desert. You'll find the camp just outside the door you use to reach the surface during the King of the Tunnel side quest. Requires you to activate the Solar Tower before it can be used.
Found in the far west of the Great Desert. You'll find the camp south of the giant freight ship and north of the Hypertube Camp. Requires you to activate the Solar Tower before it can be used.
Found in the Northern Desert area of the Great Desert. You'll find the camp next two giant rock mounds east of the ruined ship. Requires you to activate the Solar Tower before it can be used.

Found to the west of the entrance to Abyss Levoire. Follow the ridge behind the Abyss Levoire elevator to the right and you'll find the camp. Requires you to activate the Solar Tower before it can be used.

Found in the Oasis area of The Great Desert. You'll find the camp on the left-hand side of the oasis fishing lake in the centre of the area. Requires you to activate the Solar Tower before it can be used.
Found in the Emergency Exit area of Abyss Levoire. After heading down the first flight of stairs after leaving the elevator, you’ll head through a door that takes you directly to the supply camp.
Found after defeating the hive at the end of the ventilation shaft in the Emergency Exit area. Once you're behind where the hive was once hanging, look to your right and you’ll see the camp.
After progressing to the end of the Capsule Containment Room tunnel, you’ll enter a corridor with the camp on your left.
After using the control room to open the path forward and escaping the Capsule Containment Room tunnel, you’ll find the camp on your left up a flight of stairs.

Found after opening the locked gate in the Underground Passage area. Once you've battled through the horde of mutated enemies behind the locked gate in the area, you'll enter a booth overlooking another lobby. To your left will be the camp.
Found at the entrance to the Laboratory Ruins area. Right before entering the Ruins, you’ll walk through a long corridor covered in vines and other greenery. To your right in this room is the camp.

collectibles.title: Heart of the Contamination Supply Camp

description.content: Found in the Heart of the Contamination area. Right before entering the Maelstrom boss room, you’ll find the supply camp to the right of the entrance.

images.alt: Heart of the Contamination Supply Camp

description.content: After killing the first 3 Cocoons, and on your way to the objective, just after Adam tells you there's 6 more, there's a camp on the left.
When reaching the gated-off parking garage in Sector 2, continue down the nearby stairwell, and you'll eventually find a small makeshift camp.

Found to your left as soon as you enter the Submerged City area, which is reached by riding the red rollercoaster found on the path leading to the Cocoon fight on the island behind the Parking Structure.
Found while climbing up the skyscraper in the Submerged City. It's just down the ladder from the Corruptor and Dozer duo boss fight.
When climbing up the highrise building to reach one of the six cocoons, you'll find a small camp just to the left of the ladder before reaching the top of the building.

Following the rail ride, jump across the floating shipping containers and head towards the large garden in the distance. Upon arriving at Atelier, follow the path around, and you'll find a camp along the way before heading inside.

After arriving at the Orca Space Complex, you'll need to find a way up to the Central Core. Along the way, you'll need to close the water gate to enter the dam. When climbing up the ladder that leads to the dam control gate, you'll encounter a camp just to the right of the ladder when reaching the top.
Before entering the Hypertube, you'll find a supply camp beside the entrance.

collectibles.title: Space Logistics Complex Entrance Supply Camp

description.content: After being attacked by the mysterious Naytiba in the Hypertube, you'll find yourself in a new complex. Following the battle, climb the stairs in the distance, and once you reach the top, you'll find the Space Logistics Complex Entrance supply camp.

images.alt: Space Logistics Complex Entrance Supply Camp

collectibles.title: Space Logistics Complex Shipping Container Facility Camp

description.content: Following EVE's escape from the falling shipping containers, navigate up to the platform above as you head into the facility. Climb up the platform, look to your left, and you'll find a small camp that can only be reached by jumping onto the moving shipping container and then jumping across.

images.alt: Space Logistics Complex Shipping Container Facility Camp

description.content: After navigating the supply line within the Space Logistics Center, you'll come across a Supply Camp before continuing with the main story.

collectibles.title: Raphael Space Center Parking Lot Camp

description.content: Upon leaving the Space Logistics Center, you'll arrive in front of the Raphael Space Center. When jumping down the rope, you will find a small camp along the partially destroyed wall to your left.

images.alt: Raphael Space Center Parking Lot Camp

description.content: When entering the Raphael Space Center, continue forward, and you'll soon encounter a small camp at the end of the hall before heading further into the center.

collectibles.title: Raphael Space Centre Lobby Supply Camp

description.content: Upon restoring power to the Raphael Space Center, proceed through the now-unlocked gate into another open area. Defeat the patrolling Naytibas nearby and you'll find the Raphael Space Center Lobby Supply Camp in the back right corner of the area, slightly tucked away from view.

images.alt: Raphael Space Centre Lobby Supply Camp

description.content: When entering the Cargo Lift, you'll find a small camp tucked away along the wall, just to your left.

When entering the Maintenance Sector, defeat the Naytibas patrolling the area and then jump across the gap in the distance. On the other side, you'll find a small camp to your right. This is just before the wall run that you'll need to perform to continue with the story.
Once you enter the Passenger Elevator, the camp will be directly to your left.
When reaching the Prestige Lounge, you'll encounter the Prestige Lounge Supply Camp. This camp is part of the main story, so it's not possible to miss it.
When reaching High Orbit Sation, you'll find the Central Core Entrance Supply Camp just to your right after climbing up the broken elevator shaft.
As you follow the main path through the Nest, you'll find one final supply camp before encountering the Elder Naytiba.
